                                difference of opinion betwee Niazi and Farman with Governor
                                oscillating feebly between. Farman obviously desires to initiate
                                some kind of action on basis his appreciation of what he considers
                                desperate local situation. Niazi, whether on instructions from
                                Islamabad or in line with his own romantic view of himself as
                                dedicated soldier, is opposed. In effect, question boils down to
